instructions:
TableSimulator emulates passenger information boards (departure and arrival displays) driven by INISS, a railway station information system.
INISS talks to boards over lines: each line is one connection (TCP, UDP, named pipe or serial port) with a line number, and boards on a line have an address.
A board id is "line-address", e.g. "1-12".
Board families: elen (LED matrix), chars (LCD character displays), flaps (split-flap displays), amplifier (ELSVO audio amplifier switching).
Line status "connected" means INISS is connected; "lost" means INISS disconnected and the line waits for it.

tools.title: Board view data

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait at most [s], 1-60.

tools.name: clear_board
tools.title: Clear board
tools.description: Clears what a board shows; INISS fills it again with its next messages.

secondAddress.description: Second address of a two-sided board; null = only one.

family.description: elen, chars, flaps, amplifier or unknown.

design.description: Design set for the board; null = default for the manufacturer.

autoCreated.description: Created automatically by the first message to an unknown address.

poweredOff.description: Simulated power outage: the board is dark and does not answer.

fault.description: Simulated fault: kind, reply delay [ms] for delay, status bits for status.

profile.description: Board settings (size, fonts, timing); only with raw = true.

tools.name: compare_recordings
tools.title: Compare recordings
tools.description: Compares what the boards showed in two recordings, e.g. before and after a timetable change. Recordings are replayed without waiting; each board becomes a sequence of states (changes within 1 s are one state) and the sequences of A and B are aligned.

a.description: Name of the first recording (e.g. before the change).

b.description: Name of the second recording (e.g. after the change).

onlyDifferences.description: Leave out boards and steps that are the same in both recordings.

maxSteps.description: Maximum number of steps per board (1-500).

same.description: Boards that showed the same sequence of states in both recordings.

onlyA.description: Boards present only in recording A.

onlyB.description: Boards present only in recording B.

boards.description: Compared boards (without the same ones when onlyDifferences); steps align the states of A and B: same, changed, removed (only in A), added (only in B).

truncatedBoards.description: Boards whose steps were cut to maxSteps.

tools.name: delete_board
tools.title: Delete board
tools.description: Deletes a board. With auto-learning on its line the next message for its address creates it again.

tools.name: delete_design
tools.title: Delete board design
tools.description: Deletes a custom design; a built-in design with the same id is used again. Boards using a deleted design get the default one.

tools.name: delete_face
tools.title: Delete board face
tools.description: Deletes a custom face; a face used by boards cannot be deleted.

tools.name: delete_line
tools.title: Delete line
tools.description: Deletes a line together with all its boards.

tools.name: delete_virtual_board
tools.title: Delete virtual board
tools.description: Deletes a virtual board; devices showing it lose the page.

tools.name: delete_virtual_layout
tools.title: Delete virtual board layout
tools.description: Deletes a custom layout; a layout used by virtual boards cannot be deleted.

tools.name: get_design
tools.title: Board design
tools.description: Whole design: pitch and size of dots, shape, colors per ELEN font color (0 none, 1 red, 2 green, 3 yellow, mono), off dots, glow, background, plate, frame, row gaps, module seams, header fonts and colors, flap material. Colors are #rrggbb.

tools.name: get_face
tools.title: Board face
tools.description: Whole face: margins around the matrix, row groups, module width and elements. Positions and sizes are in matrix dots, measured from the edge of the anchor (face, matrix or a row) given by the alignment. Texts may contain variables {key} filled from profile.faceValues.

tools.name: get_frames
tools.title: Communication log
tools.description: Messages exchanged on the lines, oldest first: rx = from INISS to a board, tx = the board's reply. Each message has its decoded meaning (kind and arguments) and the raw bytes in hex. Only the most recent messages are kept in memory.

address.description: Only messages for this board address (use together with line).

problemsOnly.description: Only messages that were not processed normally (bad checksum, no board at the address, simulated fault, noise).

after.description: Only messages with a sequence number greater than this - pass 'next' from the previous call to read newer messages.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages (1-500); when more match, the newest are returned.

next.description: Sequence number of the newest message in the log; pass it as 'after' to get only newer messages.

truncated.description: More messages matched than the limit; the older ones were left out.

tools.name: get_iniss_station
tools.title: Station in INISS
tools.description: Preview of the station from the INISS installation set in the simulator: timetables, lines and their boards, boards INISS has but the simulator does not support, the log folder and the XML boards. Nothing is changed; import_iniss_station loads it.

tools.name: get_recent_reports
tools.title: Recent announcements
tools.description: The newest announcements from the announcement archive INISS is writing now, newest first.

tools.name: get_recording_board
tools.title: Board in a recording
tools.description: What one board showed during a recording: its states over time (changes within 1 s are one state). With time, only the state shown at that moment.

time.description: Seconds from the start of the recording; only the state shown at that moment.

limit.description: Maximum number of states from the start (1-1000).

states.description: States of the board: time [s from the start of the recording] when it changed, settled = time of the last change within the state, rows from the top.

truncated.description: More states than the limit; the later ones were left out.

tools.name: get_report_archive
tools.title: Announcement archive
tools.description: Daily archive of the announcements INISS made: time, kind, train, tracks, delays, text and result. Read from the INISS log folder set in the simulator.

date.description: Day of the archive (yyyy-MM-dd); without it the newest day is used.

train.description: Only entries of this train (part of the train number).

text.description: Only entries containing this text (diacritics ignored).

offset.description: How many matching entries to skip (paging).

date.description: Day of the archive; null = no archive found.

availableDays.description: Days with an archive, newest first (at most 31).

total.description: Number of entries matching the filter.

skipped.description: Lines of the archive file that could not be read.

tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Simulator status
tools.description: Overview of the simulator: every line with its connection status, last message time and traffic counters, the number of boards per line, and boards with a problem (simulated fault, power outage, or INISS sending messages meant for another manufacturer).

tableClass.description: INISS table class of the line, selects the protocol (e.g. 4 = ELEN, 1 = Elektrocas LCD, 128 = remote INISS).

endpoint.description: Where INISS connects: host:port, pipe name or serial port.

lastReceivedAt.description: When the last message from INISS arrived; null = none yet.

boards.description: Number of boards on the line.

issues.description: Boards with a simulated fault, power outage or manufacturer mismatch; empty when all boards are fine.

mismatch.description: INISS sends messages meant for another manufacturer; null = fine.

tools.name: get_table_archive
tools.title: Board archive
tools.description: Daily archive in which INISS logs what it sent to the boards: time, station, train, text and the values of the board columns. Read from the INISS log folder set in the simulator.

date.description: Day of the archive (yyyy-MM-dd); without it the newest day is used.

train.description: Only entries of this train (part of the train number).

text.description: Only entries containing this text (diacritics ignored).

offset.description: How many matching entries to skip (paging).

date.description: Day of the archive; null = no archive found.

availableDays.description: Days with an archive, newest first (at most 31).

total.description: Number of entries matching the filter.

skipped.description: Lines of the archive file that could not be read.

tools.name: get_traffic_statistics
tools.title: Traffic statistics
tools.description: Communication statistics, stored once a minute: totals per line (messages by result, bytes, INISS connections), totals per board (messages, replies, longest gap) and line status changes in the period. The default period is the last hour, at most 31 days.

from.description: Start of the period; default one hour before the end.

to.description: End of the period; default now.

series.description: Include the counters of each line per interval (the course over time).

bucketMinutes.description: Length of one interval of the series [min].

retentionDays.description: How many days the statistics are kept.

noBoard.description: Messages for an address without a board.

replies.description: Board replies without a simulated fault.

faults.description: Replies affected by a simulated fault (also omitted ones).

maxGapMs.description: Longest gap between two messages for the board [ms]; null = none.

statusChanges.description: Changes of the line connection status in the period.

series.description: Per-interval counters of each line; only with series = true.

tools.name: get_virtual_board
tools.title: Virtual board content
tools.description: What a virtual board shows now: the records from its XML file as cells, the layout used and a page showing the board.

source.description: The XML file the board shows; null = not found in the log folders.

rows.description: Records shown, cells in the order of the INISS catalog table: name of the XML element (time, type, number, destination...) and text; parts separated by # alternate, a text ending with # blinks.

layout.description: Layout used to draw the board.

templateError.description: With an XSL template: why the page could not be built (noSource, notFound, template, failed); null = fine or no template.

viewUrl.description: Page showing only this board; open it in a browser to see it (with login enabled the page needs signing in).

tools.name: get_virtual_layout
tools.title: Virtual board layout
tools.description: Whole layout of virtual boards: title ({name} = board name, {station} = station from the XML), clock, date, column headers, rows to fit, font, colors, columns (XML elements, label, width as fill, 12% or 6em, alignment, color text/accent/muted/delay or #rrggbb, bold, size) and alternation and blinking timing.

tools.name: import_iniss_station
tools.title: Import station from INISS
tools.description: Loads lines and boards from the INISS installation set in the simulator: missing ones are added, settings of existing lines are replaced, existing boards are kept. New boards get a face (board front) from the station data. INISS itself is not changed.

faceLanguage.description: Language of the labels on created board faces.

facesForExisting.description: Create faces also for boards that already exist.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.title: Boards
tools.description: Boards with what they show as text rows, their version, simulated fault and power state, and when the last message for them arrived.

includeText.description: Include the text rows of each board; false gives a shorter list.

family.description: elen, chars, flaps, amplifier or unknown.

version.description: Increases with every change of the content or settings; pass it to wait_for_board_change.

poweredOff.description: Simulated power outage: the board is dark and does not answer.

lastFrameAt.description: When the last message for this board arrived; null = none yet.

rows.description: What the board shows, rows from the top; an empty row is "", alternating texts are {a|b}, the moving text of an elen board is the last row "» text", split-flap modules are joined with " | ", an amplifier is "ON 1", "ON 2" or "OFF". Null when the text was not requested.

tools.name: list_designs
tools.title: Board designs
tools.description: Designs of boards - how the dots, frame, plate and flaps look (built-in and custom). A custom design with the id of a built-in one overrides it.

designs.description: Designs; renderer led-matrix = dots (LED and LCD), flaps = split-flap boards.

tools.name: list_faces
tools.title: Board faces
tools.description: Faces (board fronts): areas, labels, clocks, symbols and images around the dot matrix, shared by boards via profile.face.

builtIn.description: Built-in face; it cannot be changed, only copied.

elements.description: Number of elements (areas, texts, clocks, symbols, images).

tools.name: list_fonts
tools.title: Board fonts
tools.description: ELEN font files (.bin) in the fonts folder set in the simulator with their fonts, and the dot fonts for LCD1/ERP character boards. The font number INISS sends to an ELEN board is not a position in the file: bits 0-1 are the color, bit 2 blinking, bit 3 tall digits and bits 4-5 the face, which selects the font at that position (e.g. 0x52 = face 1, green). An extended font (bit 0x8000, n in bits 8-11) selects font n. profile.fontMap redirects them: keys face0-face3 and ext1-ext15, values are positions in the file.

index.description: Position of the font in the file: the face (bits 4-5 of the ELEN font number) or the extended font n; profile.fontMap can redirect them.

maxWidth.description: Width of the widest character in dots.

charFonts.description: Dot fonts for chars boards (LCD1, ERP) usable in profile.charFonts.

tools.name: list_recordings
tools.title: Recordings
tools.description: Recordings of the communication between INISS and the boards with their length [s], lines, number of messages and note, plus the state of the recorder and of a running replay.

tools.name: list_scenarios
tools.title: Fault scenarios
tools.description: Fault scenarios: timed steps (at [ms], duration [ms]) that simulate a board fault, a board power loss or a line outage, and for a running scenario its start, cycle and active steps. After a power loss the board is empty until INISS sends its content again.

tools.name: list_virtual_boards
tools.title: Virtual boards
tools.description: Virtual boards - screens that show the XML boards INISS writes to its log folder (like INISSView): their definitions, the XML files found, the watched folders, layouts and XSL templates.

boards.description: Virtual boards: which INISS XML board (source) they show, which records (rowStart, rowCount; null = all), separator, layout or XSL template.

sources.description: XML boards found in the INISS log folders; stale = INISS no longer refreshes the file (probably not running).

builtIn.description: Built-in layout; it cannot be changed, only copied.

columns.description: Number of columns; 0 = columns as in the XML.

defaultLayout.description: Layout of boards without their own layout.

templates.description: XSL templates in the INISSView folder set in the simulator; empty without it.

tools.name: play_recording
tools.title: Play recording
tools.description: Plays a recording into the simulator: its messages go to the boards of the recorded lines in the original timing as if INISS sent them, replies of the boards are dropped. From a position other than 0 the boards of those lines are cleared and the earlier messages are processed at once. Calling it again restarts the replay, e.g. at another position or paused. The replay ends with stop_replay.

loop.description: Play again from the start after the end.

position.description: Where to start [s from the start of the recording].

paused.description: Only prepare the position and pause.

tools.name: save_design
tools.title: Save board design
tools.description: Saves a custom design: the whole design (as from get_design), or a copy of another design (copyFrom), optionally renamed. Saving under the id of a built-in design overrides it; deleting the custom one brings the built-in back. Boards using it redraw at once.

id.description: Design id: 1-40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

design.description: The whole design; omit it when copying.

copyFrom.description: Id of a design to copy.

tools.name: save_face
tools.title: Save board face
tools.description: Saves a custom face: the whole face (as from get_face), or a copy of another face (copyFrom), optionally renamed. Built-in faces cannot be changed, only copied. Boards using the face redraw at once.

id.description: Face id: lowercase letters without diacritics, digits and hyphens.

face.description: The whole face; omit it when copying.

copyFrom.description: Id of a face to copy.

tools.name: save_scenario
tools.title: Save fault scenario
tools.description: Creates a fault scenario (without id) or replaces an existing one. Each step starts atMs after the start of the cycle and lasts durationMs: fault = the board (line + address) simulates the fault, powerLoss = the board is dark and does not answer, lineOutage = the whole line (address null) is disconnected. Steps may overlap. A one-step scenario is the way to switch a board off or cut a line for a while.

id.description: Id of the scenario to replace; null = new scenario.

loop.description: Repeat the steps in a loop.

cycleMs.description: Length of one cycle [ms]; null = until the end of the last step.

tools.name: save_virtual_board
tools.title: Save virtual board
tools.description: Creates a virtual board or changes an existing one by a partial change (JSON merge patch) of its definition: name, description, source (XML file name without extension), rowStart (first record from 1), rowCount (null = all), separator (text instead of # in station and direction; empty = parts alternate), template (XSL template; empty = by layout), parameter (attribute x for the template), layout (empty = default). Only the given keys change; null sets the default. A new board needs at least name and source.

id.description: Number of the virtual board (also in its page address #/virtual/<number>).

changes.description: Partial change of the definition (JSON merge patch).

source.description: The XML file the board shows; null = not found in the log folders.

rows.description: Records shown, cells in the order of the INISS catalog table: name of the XML element (time, type, number, destination...) and text; parts separated by # alternate, a text ending with # blinks.

layout.description: Layout used to draw the board.

templateError.description: With an XSL template: why the page could not be built (noSource, notFound, template, failed); null = fine or no template.

viewUrl.description: Page showing only this board; open it in a browser to see it (with login enabled the page needs signing in).

tools.name: save_virtual_layout
tools.title: Save virtual board layout
tools.description: Saves a custom layout: starts from a copy of another layout (copyFrom), else from the existing custom layout with this id, else from defaults, and applies a partial change (JSON merge patch, keys as in get_virtual_layout; arrays like columns are replaced whole). Built-in layouts cannot be changed, only copied. Boards using the layout redraw at once.

id.description: Layout id: lowercase letters without diacritics, digits and hyphens.

copyFrom.description: Id of a layout to copy.

changes.description: Partial change of the layout (JSON merge patch).

tools.name: send_frame
tools.title: Send bytes as INISS
tools.description: Sends bytes to a line as if INISS sent them: the boards process them (log, statistics, recording) and their replies are returned instead of being sent. Only on a line INISS is not connected to. The bytes must be whole messages of the line's protocol including checksums; messages from get_frames show the format. Returns the replies and the boards that changed.

hex.description: Bytes as hexadecimal pairs; spaces and dashes are ignored, e.g. "10 02 81 00 05 50 72 61 68 61 ...". At most 4096 bytes.

tools.name: set_board
tools.title: Create or change board
tools.description: Creates a board on a line or changes an existing one; for an existing board only the given values change. A new board needs a manufacturer and gets the default size of the manufacturer. Look, face and fonts are not changed here.

address.description: Address of the board on the line.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer (e.g. ELEN, ELEN16, LCD, LCD1, ERP, FERS, ERS, APEL, ELSVO); must belong to the class of the line.

width.description: Width of the matrix in dots.

rowHeight.description: Height of one row in dots.

secondAddress.description: Second address of a two-sided board; 0 = none.
Second address of a two-sided board; null = only one.

family.description: elen, chars, flaps, amplifier or unknown.

design.description: Design set for the board; null = default for the manufacturer.

designInUse.description: Design actually used: the board's design, or the default design of the manufacturer when none is set or it does not exist.

autoCreated.description: Created automatically by the first message to an unknown address.

poweredOff.description: Simulated power outage: the board is dark and does not answer.

fault.description: Simulated fault: kind, reply delay [ms] for delay, status bits for status.

mismatch.description: INISS sends messages meant for another manufacturer; null = fine.

profile.description: Board settings (size, fonts, timing); only with raw = true.

display.description: Raw content with fonts, character codes and positions; only with raw = true.

tools.title: Board fault
tools.description: Makes a board simulate a fault: noReply (does not answer), nak (rejects messages), delay (answers late), garbage (answers nonsense), status (reports a fault in its status reply, only boards with a status reply); none ends the fault. A running fault scenario may change it again.

kind.description: Kind of the fault; none = no fault.

secondAddress.description: Second address of a two-sided board; null = only one.

family.description: elen, chars, flaps, amplifier or unknown.

design.description: Design set for the board; null = default for the manufacturer.

designInUse.description: Design actually used: the board's design, or the default design of the manufacturer when none is set or it does not exist.

fault.description: Simulated fault: kind, reply delay [ms] for delay, status bits for status.

mismatch.description: INISS sends messages meant for another manufacturer; null = fine.

stats.description: Message counters: frames from INISS, acknowledged (acks), rejected (naks), unanswered.

clock.description: Clock time set by INISS; null = not set.

version.description: Increases with every change of the content or settings; pass it to wait_for_board_change.

rows.description: What the board shows, rows from the top; an empty row is "", alternating texts are {a|b}, the moving text of an elen board is the last row "» text", split-flap modules are joined with " | ", an amplifier is "ON 1", "ON 2" or "OFF".

profile.description: Board settings (size, fonts, timing); only with raw = true.

display.description: Raw content with fonts, character codes and positions; only with raw = true.

tools.name: set_board_look
tools.title: Board look
tools.description: Changes how one board looks: its design and a partial change of its profile (JSON merge patch - only the given keys change, null removes a key). Useful profile keys: face, faceValues, fontFile, fontMap (see list_fonts), charFonts (font number -> {font, bold}), monochrome, swapRedGreen, header, movingFont, alternationMs, blinkOnMs, blinkOffMs, scrollSpeed, rotationMs, flaps. get_board with raw = true shows the current profile. Returns the new profile, the design actually used and a page showing the board.

design.description: Design id to use; omit to keep the current one.

defaultDesign.description: Use the default design of the manufacturer instead of a set one.

profile.description: Partial change of the profile (JSON merge patch).

design.description: Design set for the board; null = default for the manufacturer.

designInUse.description: Design actually used: the board's design, or the default design of the manufacturer when none is set or it does not exist.

viewUrl.description: Page showing only this board; open it in a browser to see the result (with login enabled the page needs signing in).

tools.name: set_line
tools.title: Create or change line

endpoint.description: Where INISS connects: TCP://0.0.0.0:47001, UDP://..., \\.\PIPE\name (INISS creates the pipe) or COM3:9600,n,8,1.

tools.title: Stop recording
tools.description: Finishes the running recording and saves it.

tools.name: stop_replay
tools.title: Stop replay
tools.description: Stops the replay of a recording; the boards keep what they show.

tools.name: stop_scenario
tools.title: Stop fault scenario
tools.description: Stops a fault scenario; faults, power and lines return to the state before it.

tools.name: wait_for_board_change
tools.title: Wait for board change
tools.description: Waits until a board changes (a new message from INISS or a change of its settings) and returns what it shows then. Pass the version from list_boards or get_board; when the board already has a newer version, it returns at once. changed = false means the timeout expired without a change.

afterVersion.description: Version the caller already knows (from list_boards or get_board).

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait at most [s], 1-60.
